review_panel.finding: Audited scripts/package_source.py, scripts/check_packaging_reproducibility.py, .github/workflows/clean-room.yml, and .github/workflows/release.yml. Refactored package_source to expose modular package_source and compare_archives functions with deterministic header normalization (uid/gid 0, empty uname/gname, SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH mtime) and added comprehensive unit test suite in tests/test_alpha_release_packaging.py.

Audited workflow permission matrices, action commit SHA pinnings, pull_request_target restrictions, and clean-room offline build/install gates via scripts/check_workflow_hardening.py and verification/harness-matrix.json. Confirmed clean-room offline installation and MCP discovery transcript requirements remain strictly gated on passing local and CI evidence.

Verified scripts/generate_source_sbom.py and scripts/generate_source_hash_manifest.py contracts. Verified source-level CycloneDX inventory generation without overclaiming full binary dependency resolution prior to release build, and verified repository-local SHA-256 manifest integrity excluding volatile receipt outputs.

Upgraded all six Track 18 assertions (T18-A001..T18-A006) from track_level_only (6/6 empty symbols) to symbol_and_gate_mapped with concrete implementation symbols across scripts/package_source.py, scripts/check_packaging_reproducibility.py, scripts/generate_source_sbom.py, scripts/generate_source_hash_manifest.py, scripts/mcp_smoke.py, scripts/check_cli_distribution.py, scripts/check_workflow_hardening.py, and scripts/check_release_rehearsal.py in both conductor/tracks/18-alpha-release/traceability.json and conductor/traceability-overrides.json (0/6 empty symbols).

Preserved release gating state without premature completion: implementation_state remains scaffolded; external release/signing/tagging blockers (verifying committed Cargo.lock, clean-room cross-platform binary builds, container image build, cryptographic provenance and attestations) remain explicitly open.

fixes_applied: Refactored scripts/package_source.py to expose modular package_source with deterministic timestamp, file sorting, and metadata generation.
Refactored scripts/check_packaging_reproducibility.py to expose modular compare_archives and run_package helpers with optional test flag.

Created tests/test_alpha_release_packaging.py exercising sha256 hashing, SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH handling, tracked file filtering, member verification, archive mismatch detection, and full package_source artifact generation with normalized TAR/ZIP headers.

Upgraded assertions T18-A001 through T18-A006 to symbol_and_gate_mapped with concrete implementation symbols, deterministic tests, and native test commands in both conductor/tracks/18-alpha-release/traceability.json and conductor/traceability-overrides.json (0/6 empty symbol mappings).
Preserved open release blockers: verifying committed Cargo.lock, clean-room cross-platform binary builds, container image build, and signed release artefacts without false promotion.
